definitions.explanation: A reduction in job rank, position, or status.

examples.japanese: {不祥事|ふしょうじ}で{降格|こうかく}させられた。
examples.english: I was demoted due to a scandal.

examples.japanese: {降格|こうかく}{人事|じんじ}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: A demotion was announced in the personnel changes.

examples.japanese: {成績|せいせき}が{悪|わる}いと{降格|こうかく}の{可能性|かのうせい}がある。
examples.english: Poor performance may lead to demotion.

notes:
{降格|こうかく} is a compound: {降|こう} (descend) + {格|かく} (rank).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {降格|こうかく}する (to be demoted)
- {降格|こうかく}させる (to demote someone)
- {降格|こうかく}{人事|じんじ} (personnel changes involving demotion)
- {降格|こうかく}{処分|しょぶん} (demotion as disciplinary action)

CONTRAST:
- {昇格|しょうかく} (promotion in rank - opposite)
- {昇進|しょうしん} (promotion)

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {左遷|させん} (transfer to a less desirable position)
- {解雇|かいこ} (dismissal)
- {減給|げんきゅう} (salary reduction)
